name: Desktop application
description: Window shell, native capability, persistence, and shutdown contracts for desktop applications.

invariants.title: Window shell is an explicit product decision
invariants.statement: A branded desktop application uses one integrated application shell by default; retaining native decorations requires an explicit project override and removes duplicate in-app window controls.
preflight: Choose integrated or native-explicit before implementing layout.
Assign titlebar, navigation, content header, and border ownership.
evidence: The real desktop window shows exactly one titlebar strategy.
Content separators do not extend into navigation unless the shell owns them.
Window controls work at normal and maximized sizes.

invariants.title: Every native call has a matching capability
invariants.statement: Each user action maps through one frontend boundary to one native command and the exact permission granted to the target window.
preflight: Map window, filesystem, dialog, opener, and process calls before UI completion.
Keep raw native errors out of user-facing messages.
evidence: The real command succeeds from the target window.
Permission failure paths produce an actionable product message.
The terminal and UI contain no unhandled not-allowed error.

invariants.title: Shutdown preserves user state
invariants.statement: Custom close controls, system close controls, and shortcuts enter one idempotent save, conflict, flush, and exit coordinator.
preflight: Distinguish close window, hide, and exit application.
Define behavior for dirty state, conflicts, save failure, and repeated close requests.
evidence: A dirty document is closed through the real UI and is present after restart.
A save failure keeps recoverable state available.
The process reaches the intended final state.

checks.message: Choose one desktop window shell strategy.
Desktop shutdown must flush project state before normal close.
The top-level app shell must own the titlebar layout.

manual_verification.title: Real window shell
steps: Run the real desktop window rather than a browser preview.
Inspect normal, maximized, restored, and minimum sizes in light and dark themes.
Verify titlebar, navigation, and content borders remain in their owned regions.

manual_verification.title: Close, flush, exit, and restart
steps: Close from the custom control and then from the system control.
Restart and confirm the formal consumer reads the saved state.
